200.description:
Read one Senate eFD filing by report_kind and report_id (from search_reports), or by its pasted efdsearch.senate.gov/search/view/ URL. Four detail families: ptr (GET /search/view/ptr/{id}/): title, filer name, filed-at text and date, the certification statements, and the transactions table (number, date, owner, ticker or null, asset name, asset type, transaction type, amount range text with parsed min/max dollars, comment or null); annual (GET /search/view/annual/{id}/, also Candidate reports and amendments): title, filer, filed-at, certifications and every Part section (number, title, yes/no question and answer, the table's column headers and rows as text cells, notes); paper (GET /search/view/paper/{id}/, scanned filings incl. all blind-trust and other-document reports): page_count and pages[] with the page image URL on efd-media-public.senate.gov (anonymous GIFs, not fetched); extension_notice (GET /search/view/extension-notice/regular/{id}/): filer name, notice text and the new due date. Filed-at timestamps carry no timezone on the page and are kept as text plus the calendar date. Sections not applicable to the family are omitted. An unknown report_id is answered by the site with a redirect to the search form and reported as not_found. LEGAL NOTICE (5 U.S.C. app. 105(c)): it is unlawful to obtain or use a report for any unlawful purpose; for any commercial purpose other than by news and communications media for dissemination to the general public; for determining or establishing the credit rating of any individual; or for use, directly or indirectly, in the solicitation of money for any political, charitable or other purpose. The caller must set acknowledge_use_prohibitions to true; otherwise the function fails with invalid_input and contacts nothing.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `certifications` | object[] | ptr, annual: the statements the filer checked (or left unchecked) before filing. |
| `extension` | object | extension_notice only. |
| `filed_at_text` | string | ptr, annual: the 'Filed MM/DD/YYYY @ h:mm AM/PM' stamp as rendered; no timezone is stated on the page. |
| `filed_date` | string | ptr, annual: calendar date of filed_at_text. |
| `filer_name` | string | ptr, annual, extension_notice: the filer as named on the page (e.g. 'The Honorable Sheldon Whitehouse (Whitehouse, Sheldon)'). Omitted for paper filings, whose pages carry no name. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_count` | number | paper only. |
| `pages` | object[] | paper only: scanned page images in order. |
| `parts` | object[] | annual only: every section of the report in page order (Part 1 .. Part 10, then Attachments & Comments). |
| `prohibitions_notice` | string |  |
| `report_id` | string |  |
| `report_kind` | string |  |
| `report_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string | The page heading, e.g. 'Periodic Transaction Report for 10/01/2026', 'Annual Report for Calendar 2025', 'Annual Report for 2019 Due Date Extension 1'; paper filings have only the viewer heading 'Filing Document - Print View'. |
| `transactions` | object[] | ptr only: every row of the Transactions table. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

extension.text: Elizabeth Warren timely requested an extension of time for filing the annual Public Financial Disclosure Report. Pursuant to section 101(g) of the Ethics in Government Act of 1978, as amended, a 90-day extension was granted and the new due date for the report is no later than August 13, 2020.

value.prohibitions_notice: Title 1 of the Ethics in Government Act of 1978, as amended, 5 U.S.C. app. § 105(c), states that: It shall be unlawful for any person to obtain or use a report: for any unlawful purpose; for any commercial purpose, other than by news and communications media for dissemination to the general public; for determining or establishing the credit rating of any individual; or for use, directly or indirectly, in the solicitation of money for any political, charitable, or other purpose. The Attorney General may bring a civil action against any person who obtains or uses a report for any purpose prohibited in paragraph (1) of this subsection. The court in which such action is brought may assess against such person a penalty in any amount not to exceed $10,000. Such remedy shall be in addition to any other remedy available under statutory or common law.

post.description: Find Senate financial disclosure filings (PTRs, annual reports, extensions, blind trusts, paper filings) by Senator or candidate name, state, report type or date, and obtain report_id values for get_report.

acknowledge_use_prohibitions.description: Must be true: the caller affirms the prohibitions on obtaining and using financial disclosure reports in 5 U.S.C. app. 105(c) (no unlawful or commercial use other than by news media, no credit rating, no solicitation of money). The program submits the site's acknowledgement only on the caller's behalf after this affirmation.

candidate_state.description: Two-letter state code of the candidate's race. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's meta.page.next_cursor (the next start offset). Pattern: ^\d{1,7}$.

filer_types.description: Restrict to filer types (site codes 1, 4, 5). Empty or absent: all.

filter_text.description: Free-text filter applied by the site across all result columns (the DataTables search box); records_filtered reflects it.

last_name.description: Filer last name, prefix match as on the site (for example 'Warren').

page_size.description:
Rows per page, 1-100 (the site's maximum).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

report_types.description: Restrict to report types: annual (Annual and Candidate reports incl. amendments, code 7), ptr (Periodic Transaction Reports, 11), extension (Due Date Extension notices, 10), blind_trust (14), other (Other Documents, 15). Empty or absent: all.

senator_state.description: Two-letter state code of the Senator's seat. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

sort_by.description:
Sort column. Default date_received.

Provider reference: allowed values ["first_name", "last_name", "filer", "report", "date_received"]; default "date_received".

sort_dir.description:
Sort direction. Default desc (newest first).

Provider reference: allowed values ["asc", "desc"]; default "desc".

submitted_from.description: Earliest date received, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default 2012-01-01, the site's minimum. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

submitted_to.description: Latest date received, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, through 23:59:59). Default: open-ended. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

200.description:
Search the Senate eFD filing index (POST /search/report/data/, the DataTables endpoint behind the Find Reports form). Filters: last_name and first_name (prefix match), filer_types (senator, candidate, former_senator), report_types (annual, ptr, extension, blind_trust, other), senator_state and candidate_state (two-letter codes), submitted_from / submitted_to (date received, YYYY-MM-DD; the site indexes filings from 2012-01-01), filter_text (the table's free-text filter across all columns), sort_by and sort_dir. Offset pagination with page_size (1-100) and continuation (the next start offset). Each row carries the filer's first and last name, the filer label as shown (for example 'Warren, Elizabeth (Senator)'), the report title, the report kind derived from the detail link (ptr, annual, paper, extension_notice), the report_id (UUID) and URL for get_report, and the date received (MM/DD/YYYY as given plus ISO). records_total is the count for the structured filters, records_filtered additionally applies filter_text. A search with no matches is a valid empty result. LEGAL NOTICE (5 U.S.C. app. 105(c)): it is unlawful to obtain or use a report for any unlawful purpose; for any commercial purpose other than by news and communications media for dissemination to the general public; for determining or establishing the credit rating of any individual; or for use, directly or indirectly, in the solicitation of money for any political, charitable or other purpose. The caller must set acknowledge_use_prohibitions to true; otherwise the function fails with invalid_input and contacts nothing.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `prohibitions_notice` | string | The statutory use prohibitions the caller acknowledged (5 U.S.C. app. 105(c)), as stated on efdsearch.senate.gov/search/home/. |
| `records_filtered` | number | Filings matching the structured filters and filter_text; the total this page is drawn from. |
| `records_total` | number | Filings matching the structured filters (before filter_text). |
| `reports` | object[] |  |
| `start` | number | Zero-based offset of the first row on this page. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
